label: GO step, confident a2 choice after a common prior transition, mid-episode (trials ~30-70)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), and only when the agent picks a2 (11466 of 11467 activations are a2; model_act == 2 always). Everything sits in the most negative policy-logit bins (choice < -4.4, 75% of mass below -8.9). It never fires when the previous trial had a rare transition, so in practice the previous trial was a2 reaching S2 via the common transition (or there is no previous trial in the window). There is a strong episode-time window: almost nothing before trial 20 or after trial 75, peaking at trials 40-69. Value is mid-to-high (7.1-8.1), and it is silent at the highest and lowest values. Previous reward barely matters. It does NOT fire at D1/D2, on a1 choices, or after a rare transition. Even with all these conditions precision is only ~0.2: the unit fires on a minority of qualifying GO steps, so other unexplained state (possibly a slow episode clock) gates it. The recorded predicate uses the observed policy logit instead of the upcoming action. The equivalent with action == 2 (the agent's own choice) scores F1 0.27 with mass recall 0.91.
